title: Independent modal to alpha arithmetic chain
counting_scope: One additional method-chain fixture, outside the 73 primary examples, the 44 production records, and both historical 333-record scopes.
source_identity_canonicalization: SHA-256 of inputs serialized as ASCII JSON with sorted keys and separators comma/colon, without whitespace.

source_refs.atlas_reason: Normative source not reproduced in the example-source atlas.

source_refs.title: CSI ETABS Help Load Case Data Response Spectrum
source_refs.scope: Modal and directional settings, modal damping and applied diaphragm eccentricity are distinct concepts; version-specific implementation requires native evidence.

scope.geometry: S2, the 3 m middle storey of a declared three-storey frame with four column lines and no walls. Column lines continue above and below both bounding joints. The plan diaphragm is 10 m by 10 m; column coordinates are supplied.
scope.force_scope: A complete declared signed-modal response-field population for 16 column-end cuts, four eccentricity/direction cases, and two modal terms per case. These are test inputs, not the output of a newly solved finite-element eigenproblem.
scope.capacity_scope: Analytic lower-bound capacity input curves and revision tokens. No concrete strain compatibility or physical bar-cage calculation is performed by this fixture.
scope.other_governing_checks: Section dimensions, axial material limits, detailing, PMM, joint shear and physical bar selection require their existing production owners and separate independent references. They are not accepted by this fixture.

units_and_signs.axial: N > 0 is compression; the conversion from a CSI force convention must be recorded by the adapter.
units_and_signs.global_axes: Right-handed XYZ with Z upward. Column local 1=global Z, local 2=global X, local 3=global Y in this fixture.
units_and_signs.moment_mapping: X-excitation bending uses moment about global Y / local 3. Y-excitation bending uses moment about global X / local 2.
units_and_signs.cut_sign: Fx and Fy act on the same upward-looking physical storey cut. End moments have the declared I/J section signs; opposite element-side rows are retained.
units_and_signs.spectral_semantics: Every CQC/directional result is a scalar magnitude or interval. No array of component extrema is labelled a simultaneous force vector.

inputs.scaling_scope: Fixture scalars only; no claim that these factors are accepted for an actual building.

precision_fixture.meaning: A numerical stress fixture; not an observed ETABS result or defect.

tolerances.reason: The source is a deliberately exact decimal fixture; these are numerical reproducibility bounds, not engineering reserve factors or tolerances for unknown native source precision. Source-row strings preserve at least 15 significant digits.

missing_actual_model_evidence.item: Local committed and uncommitted implementation bytes
missing_actual_model_evidence.required: The a2e26b6 target tree, diff/untracked inventory and per-file hashes; do not replace it with published source.
Native amplitude normalization, actual damping including overrides, mode inventory, case scaling and frequency/period precision for each observed response-spectrum case.
Diaphragm membership/width, default and overwritten eccentricities, actual applied torsional contributions and the combination order used by the installed ETABS build.
Complete physical/end-face inventory, all neighbouring columns and beam faces, units, axes, release/offset rules and same-generation analysis-element linkage.
Direction-compatible axial-demand family and an accepted minimum-capacity search over that family; no substitution of maximum compression or unrelated PMM vector extrema.
Existing production capacity owner on independently validated, explicitly bound actual/selected bar cages for every column and connected beam; the analytic curves here are not RC capacities.
An accepted shared-phase or modal-aggregate method for actual non-proportional member fields; a clipped ratio of independently enveloped maxima is insufficient.
The existing alpha owner and downstream PMM/shear/joint owners must consume the same frozen source and revision chain, record all intermediate results, and repeat identically.

necessary_conditions: The box contains every admissible concurrent demand vector for the same model, generation, case family, physical cut and coordinate convention.
The compared resistance set is certified convex in the same N-M2-M3 coordinates and uses one fixed geometry/material/cage revision.
All eight vertices and axial-domain restrictions are checked; the comparison has no unhandled singularity, tension/compression branch or interpolation extrapolation.
The demand transformation is affine, or a separate proof establishes a valid enclosing set after every nonlinear transformation.
nonlinear_evidence_required: For N-dependent moment magnification: domain bounds, denominator strictly separated from zero, monotonicity or certified interval image bounds, and interior stationary/boundary checks where needed.
For capacity interpolation or candidate changes: convexity/error bounds and fixed-cage applicability. A vertex result for several different cages proves no single feasible cage.
Where those proofs are absent, use verified concurrent vectors or certified global bounds; add witnesses and retain NOT_PROVEN for whole-box sufficiency.

counterexample.meaning: All eight corners pass while an interior N station on the M2 face fails. The example has a nonconvex accepted set and is a mathematical counterexample, not an RC capacity model.
